name: Lemon juice salad dressing
author: martin-chrzanowski on based.cooking

ingredients.item: Lemon juice from half a lemon

steps: Combine lemon juice and oil in small bowl.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Add the garlic, pressed or finely minced.
Mix well before adding to salad.

culture.text: A salad dressing is a sauce for salads, especially leafy salads.
